newsitem.title: USA: Sears, Orchard Supply deal clears hurdle.
newsitem.headline: Sears, Orchard Supply deal clears hurdle.

text.p: Sears, Roebuck and Co. said Monday the Hart-Scott-Rodino antitrust waiting period had expired for its planned $415 million acquisition of Orchard Supply Hardware Stores Corp.
In August, Sears offered $35 for each share of San Jose, California-based Orchard, which operates 61 medium-sized hardware stores.
